SELECT sd.id, sd.main_id, sd.sku_id, sd.sku_no, si.warehouse_org_id AS inventoryOrgId, sd.qty AS salesQty, sd.amount AS salesAmount, sd.is_gift, sd.is_close, sd.remark, si.warehouse_id, sd.currency, sd.currency_Symbol FROM so_detail sd INNER JOIN so_info si ON sd.main_id = si.id AND sd.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN so_return sr ON sr.source_id = si.id AND sr.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE si.is_deleted = FALSE
AND sr.id = #{id}
